stories.headline: AMD is buying Fei-Fei Li's AI startup for $8 billion
stories.blurb: AMD announced it's acquiring World Labs, the AI research lab co-founded by prominent researcher Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock deal worth $8.2 billion. World Labs launched in 2024, hit a $1 billion valuation in months, and just shipped its first commercial product — a world generation model.
stories.why_it_matters: AMD is making its biggest AI bet yet to compete with Nvidia's dominance in AI chips.
stories.original_headline: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion

stories.headline: OpenAI shelves its newest AI model after internal safety alarms
stories.blurb: OpenAI won't release GPT-6.1 Astra after its own researchers flagged security concerns. The company hasn't detailed what risks triggered the hold, but it's the first time OpenAI has publicly pulled a finished model before launch.
stories.why_it_matters: Even AI leaders are hitting limits they won't cross — at least not yet.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI Says It Will Not Release Newest Astra A.I. Model Over Safety Concerns

stories.headline: Grok can now be a shared teammate that knows your company's stuff
stories.blurb: xAI just launched Team Bots — Grok instances you can feed your files, connect to your apps, and share across your team so everyone works from the same context. Think of it as a chatbot that actually knows what your team knows, not just generic training data.
stories.why_it_matters: First shared-context AI agent you can set up without building your own RAG pipeline.
stories.original_headline: Team Bots: AI coworkers that learn from your team

stories.headline: Shopify just let AI agents check out and buy things for you
stories.blurb: Shopify now allows browser-based AI agents to complete purchases on your behalf, updating order details and finishing checkout once you give the OK. The feature uses WebMCP, a protocol that lets agents interact with websites directly through your browser.
stories.why_it_matters: AI can now handle the entire shopping flow, not just browse and recommend.
stories.original_headline: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents

stories.headline: Marissa Mayer's new app reads your entire camera roll to learn who you are
stories.blurb: Dazzle analyzes every photo on your phone to figure out your hobbies, food preferences, style, and who you spend time with. Mayer's bet: your camera roll reveals more about your life than your email inbox ever could.
stories.why_it_matters: Personal AI is moving from text to images as the primary data source for understanding users.
stories.original_headline: With Dazzle, Marissa Mayer bets your camera roll has more info on your life than your inbox

stories.headline: A team just made ChatGPT drive a Toyota Corolla through a parking lot
stories.blurb: Tech workers connected frontier LLMs directly to a car's controls with zero prior training data and had it navigate a simple parking lot course. The models processed camera feeds in real time and made steering, acceleration, and braking decisions on the fly.
stories.why_it_matters: You can now wire a chatbot to physical controls and get basic autonomous behavior without specialized training.
stories.original_headline: These Tech Workers Made ChatGPT Drive a Toyota Corolla
